title: Add per-user accounts with privacy controls and create a landing page

requirements.text: Implement per-user account system in the backend where each authenticated user has their own isolated reminders and messages storage, replacing the current shared public-mode data model
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores reminders and messages per Principal ID instead of in shared maps
Each user can only access their own reminders and messages
Authorization checks prevent one user from viewing or modifying another user's data

requirements.text: Re-enable Internet Identity authentication requirement so users must log in before accessing the organizer and messaging features
acceptanceCriteria: LoginButton component is visible and functional
Unauthenticated users see a landing page instead of the main app
After login, users are routed to their personal reminders view

requirements.text: Create a landing page that displays before authentication, introducing the app's purpose and features with a prominent login button
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page is shown to unauthenticated visitors
Page includes app name, tagline, and brief description of features (reminders, messaging, voice input)
Login button is clearly visible and functional
After successful login, user is redirected to the main app view

requirements.text: Update messaging system to support sending messages to specific authenticated users by selecting or entering their identity
acceptanceCriteria: MessageComposer includes a recipient selector or input field
Backend stores recipient information with each message
Users can only view messages they sent or messages sent to them
Sending a reminder as a message includes proper recipient routing

requirements.text: Restore ProfileSetupDialog flow for first-time authenticated users to set their display name
acceptanceCriteria: First-time users see profile setup dialog after logging in
User can enter and save their display name
Display name is shown in the app header and messaging UI

constraints: Use single-actor Motoko architecture in backend/main.mo
Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain compatibility with existing React Query hooks in useQueries.ts
nonGoals: Implementing role-based access control or admin features
Adding user-to-user friend requests or contact lists
Adding profile pictures or extended user profiles beyond display name

required: Hero illustration for landing page showing a person organizing tasks with voice input (hero-landing.dim_1200x600.png)
App logo icon for landing page header (logo-icon.dim_128x128.png)
